dataset_title: Human monocyte-derived macrophage ATAC-seq; acute high-dose endotoxin (LPS) activation (HD) vs untreated (UT) vs endotoxin tolerance (LDHD); GRCh38 pooled bedgraph coverage.
contrast: untreated (UT) vs acute LPS (HD) vs LPS-tolerance (LDHD)

a_accessibility.metric: overlapping-bin-safe per-base MAX coverage as enrichment FOLD over each sample's own chr22 background mean positive coverage (scale-free; corrects the deposited bedgraphs' differing global depth); median reported for robustness

b_honest_label: chromVAR-style NRF2 motif-hit / best-score enrichment WITHIN real accessible peaks (single TF, real-peak sequences). It is a motif-accessibility PROXY on real peaks, NOT a full chromVAR deviation across matched-activity background peaks.

c_peak_to_gene.note: linear-distance peak->TSS assignment; NOT an ATAC-RNA correlation (no matched expression).

honest_scope: Real human macrophage (myeloid) LPS-activation ATAC reference -- NOT an SAH / heme / human-brain scATAC experiment. No openly-downloadable, tractable-size SAH/ICH/microglia scATAC peak or fragment file was found (GEO scATAC bundles login-gated / multi-GB; ENCODE has ~1 monocyte ATAC, 0 microglia ATAC). Answers 'which cell type has HMOX1 ARE-chromatin capacity under inflammatory stimulation', not 'which brain cell opens HMOX1 in SAH'.
